facts.fact_text: On 20 January 2012, Mr Nagibin and five other persons notified the Rostov-on-Don Town Administration of their intention to hold a public event in support of fair elections in the centre of Rostov-on-Don.
At 2.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin, together with an unspecified number of persons, arrived in Teatralnaya Square.
At 2.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin and the persons accompanying him joined the public event organised by the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia at Teatralnaya Square.
At the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia's public event at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin spoke out on the alleged illegality of the State Duma elections.

At the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia's public event at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin distributed leaflets in support of his position regarding the alleged illegality of the State Duma elections.
On 23 January 2012, the Rostov-on-Don Town Administration refused to approve the time of the public event proposed by Mr Nagibin and five other persons.
On 23 January 2012, the Rostov-on-Don Town Administration refused to approve any of the proposed locations of the public event proposed by Mr Nagibin and five other persons.
A police officer present at Teatralnaya Square on 4 February 2012 ordered Mr Nagibin, and others who had arrived with him, to stop their unauthorised meeting and to leave the square.
At 3.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin was arrested and taken to the police station for the purposes of compiling an administrative-offence record.

On 11 April 2012, the justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don found Mr Nagibin guilty under Article 20.2 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences for holding an unauthorised public event.

The justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don fined Mr Nagibin 1,000 Russian roubles, equivalent to about 26 euros at the time of the judgment on 11 April 2012.

With regard to Teatralnaya Square in particular, Mr Nagibin and other event organisers were informed that another public event, namely 'For honest and clean democracy', was already scheduled to be held by the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia at the same time and location.
At 2.30 p.m. on 4 February 2012, Mr Nagibin and the persons accompanying him joined the public event organised by the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia at Teatralnaya Square.

The justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don dismissed Mr Nagibin's argument that he had simply joined the Liberal Democratic Party of Russia's public event, which was in line with the message he had wished to convey.
The justice of the peace of the 3rd Circuit of the Proletarskiy District of Rostov-on-Don dismissed Mr Nagibin's argument that he had not staged a public event of his own.
